title: Contari
creator: fawaztechyt
summary: November 22, 2026: React/Vite and Supabase preview for encrypted note lockers with wallet allowlists. Although note encryption happens in the client, the server holds a master key and the operator can decrypt notes; this is not operator-blind end-to-end encryption. Legacy URL-key lockers refuse unlocking. The README says contract publication/instantiation and wallet integration testing remain pending. Sapient or a compatible web-wallet provider is required for intended wallet flows. No locker was created or accessed. Review used original submission text, README, license metadata and extracted public-page text. Creator test results were not rerun. This recording is a continuous README walkthrough with page scripts and downloads disabled; no wallet, funds or third-party code was operated.
cardSummary: Explore encrypted note sharing with wallet-based access lists in a preview that uses operator-managed decryption keys.
